scientific_interpretation.polygon_features: Use overlap weights; do not collapse multi-district IPC analysis areas to one district.
scientific_interpretation.point_features: Urban/IDP points are reference/display locations, not footprint geometry; areal weights are undefined.
scientific_interpretation.temporal_scope: The GeoJSON is a snapshot. Exact title matching identifies candidate assessment periods but does not prove historical boundary stability.

wfp_banadir.conclusion: HDX/WFP encodes Banadir as #adm2+name, but it duplicates admin1 and does not name a canonical district. Preserve and quarantine that source label; use market coordinates for a separate point-to-district relationship without overwriting admin2.
